headline: REC solar equipment for homeowners
summary: Top-tier reliability with the 25-year ProTrust warranty covering product, performance, and labor. Compare warranties and architecture on your quote — then find local installers via a SolarFlow project for your address.

questions_to_ask_installer: Is this REC SKU still under active warranty registration for U.S. residential installs?
What labor coverage applies if a module fails in year 8–12?
red_flags: Quotes that list REC without model numbers or warranty documents.

sections.heading: How to read this brand on a quote
sections.body: Ask for exact model numbers, datasheets, and who registers the warranty. Brand blurbs are not substitutes for the paperwork attached to your contract.

faqs.question: Is REC a good choice in 2026?
faqs.answer: It depends on price, warranty enforceability, installer familiarity, and how the rest of the system is designed. Use our local search after creating a project — we don’t publish national fake dealer lists.

cta.primary: Find local installers who quote REC near your address
cta.copy: Create a free SolarFlow project for your home — we’ll use your roof model and location for a local search. Equipment pages don’t show national pricing as gospel.
